pr_title: tests: arch: arm_irq_vector_table: Update to run on MXRT685
pr_body:
Fixes #35658
Update the custom vector table to add the OS Event timer interrupt which is used on RT685 as the kernel system timer
pr_comments: Anything else needed for this PR?

issue_context.title: arch.interrupt.arm.irq_vector_table.arm_irq_vector_table: MPU FAULT Halting system for mximxrt685_evk_cm33
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug**
irq_vector_table test hangs

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. mkdir build; cd build
2. cmake -Dmimxrt685_evk_cm33 ..
3. make; make flash
4. See error

**Expected behavior**
PASS

**Impact**
irq vector teable

**Logs and console output**

```
E: ***** MPU FAULT *****
E:   Instruction Access Violation
E: r0/a1:  0x180044b1  r1/a2:  0x00000000  r2/a3:  0x180044b1
E: r3/a4:  0x30180868 r12/ip:  0xa0000000 r14/lr:  0xfffffffd
E:  xpsr:  0x68000039
E: Faulting instruction address (r15/pc): 0xfb06fef6
E: >>> ZEPHYR FATAL ERROR 0: CPU exception on CPU 0
E: Fault during interrupt handling
E: Current thread: 0x30180218 (main)
E: Halting system
```

**Environment (please complete the following information):**
 - OS: (e.g. Linux)
 - Toolchain (e.g Zephyr SDK, ...)
 - Commit SHA or Version used: v2.6.0-rc1-323-gae4fb20f6733
comments: @MaureenHelm , @dleach02 , @mmahadevan108 , this issue also existing in RC1

git bisect landed on commit ff398d81a46596cdc18b7fe5ea4ae24d8599940c:
```
commit ff398d81a46596cdc18b7fe5ea4ae24d8599940c
Author: Mahesh Mahadevan <mahesh.mahadevan@nxp.com>
Date:   Fri Apr 23 16:50:13 2021 -0500

    drivers: timer: rt600: Update SYS_CLOCK_TICKS_PER_SEC
    
    Use the default value as we were failing kernel
    timer tests with the increased value
    
    Signed-off-by: Mahesh Mahadevan <mahesh.mahadevan@nxp.com>
```

This issue seems to be related to switching the kernel tick timer away from SYSTICK to OS Event timer. The test is failing the below lines
https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/blob/main/tests/arch/arm/arm_interrupt/src/arm_interrupt.c#L336-L353
because the test is expecting a CPU exception and RT600 is throwing a Kernel Panic. 

I am not clear how to address this.

I think the test needs to be updated similar to Nordic platforms:
https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/blob/45bd3dee08ef9804fd4684ae20fde4e53af2c0f2/tests/arch/arm/arm_irq_vector_table/src/arm_irq_vector_table.c#L177-L196

review_comments:
Unless it is absolutely necessary, we should not be adding test-related code to the driver itself; if any, `test_mcux_lpc_ostick_isr` should be implemented on the test-side (i.e. in `arm_irq_vector_table.c`).

p.s. the function prototype mismatch certainly is ugly and should not be allowed in any code that actually ends up in the product; but, given the nature of this test (i.e. it's Arm-specific and more importantly a test), I think allowing it may not be a completely unreasonable implementation decision. Also, note that this is not the first instance of function prototype mismatch in this file. If we are going to fix it, we should fix the rest as well.
